summary: Implemented the Databricks OAuth profile mapping. Added cosmos/profiles/databricks/oauth.py with DatabricksOauthProfileMapping (required fields host, schema, http_path, client_id, client_secret; secret fields client_id and client_secret; client_id from login then extra.client_id, client_secret from password then extra.client_secret; profile sets auth_type to oauth and env-var references for both secrets). Registered it in cosmos/profiles/__init__.py directly after DatabricksTokenProfileMapping in profile_mappings and in __all__, and exported it from cosmos/profiles/databricks/__init__.py. Added tests/profiles/databricks/test_dbr_oauth.py covering claiming, token-over-OAuth selection, OAuth selection, profile and env-var output, and profile args not overriding auth_type or secrets. Tests were not run, per instructions; verification was by reading only. Known gap: env_vars reads through the base get_dbt_value, which gives profile args priority, so a caller-supplied client_id or client_secret would change the env-var value even though the profile still references the env var. Fixing this needs a base-class or override change, which the spec excluded, so it was left for a decision. Nothing was committed.
